name: Ushers
overview: Scripture highlights the humble and faithful role of ushers as those who serve willingly and wholeheartedly in the house of God, valuing their service as done unto the Lord rather than men (Ephesians 6:7; Colossians 3:23). The imagery of doorkeepers or porters in Psalms and John illustrates the importance of their responsibility in guarding the spiritual threshold and guiding the people of God (Psalms 84:10; John 10:3). Additionally, the call to hospitality and meeting the needs of fellow believers (Romans 12:13) underscores the ushers’ ministry as one of practical love and watchfulness (Proverbs 8:34).
